name: Multi Claims Hatter
details: A hatter contract enabling accounts that are explicitly eligible for a hat to claim it.
This version is compatible with HatsModuleFactory v0.7.0, which uses a saltNonce parameter for module deployments.
This version also supports hooks, enabling additional actions to be bundled with hat claims.

mutable.name: Initial Claimable Hats
mutable.description: The IDs of the hats to set claimability for

mutable.name: Initial Claimability Types
mutable.description: '1' to make a hat claimable by its wearers, '2' to make a hat also claimable on behalf of wearers

mutable.name: Initial Mint Hooks
mutable.description: The addresses of the mint hooks to set for each hat. Use zero address to skip setting a mint hook.
